spec.title: Delivered Event Traffic Rate
spec.description: Tracks the actual cost of traffic after events have been sequenced and successfully delivered.

spec.title: Rejected Event Traffic Rate
spec.description: Shows the traffic cost per second of requests that were sequenced but not delivered successfully by the sequencer. The reason for rejection should be visible in the next graph.

spec.title: Submitted vs Delivered Traffic
spec.description: Difference in traffic cost for events between submission and successful delivery after sequencing. Small differences can be present due to the time lag between the recorded metrics particularly if there are many requests in-flight to be sequenced.

spec.expr:
avg_over_time((
    sum by(type) (daml_sequencer_client_traffic_control_submitted_event_cost_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", synchronizer="$synchronizer"})
    -
    sum by(type) (daml_sequencer_client_traffic_control_event_delivered_cost_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", synchronizer="$synchronizer"})
)[2m:10s])

spec.title: Submitted Event Traffic Rate
spec.description: Tracks the traffic cost of events at the time of submission before they've been sequenced.

spec.title: Event Submission Rate
spec.description: Number of requests that are in-flight, overloaded or dropped per second in the sequencer client.

spec.title: Extra Traffic Consumed over the last 24h
Submitted vs Delivered Traffic By Application ID
spec.description: Difference in traffic cost for confirmation requests and responses between submission and successful delivery after sequencing (per application).

spec.expr:
avg_over_time((
    sum by(application_id) (daml_sequencer_client_traffic_control_submitted_event_cost_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", synchronizer="$synchronizer", type="send-confirmation-request"})
    -
    sum by(application_id) (daml_sequencer_client_traffic_control_event_delivered_cost_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", synchronizer="$synchronizer", type="send-confirmation-request"})
)[2m:10s])

avg_over_time((
    sum without(target_sequencer) (daml_sequencer_client_traffic_control_submitted_event_cost_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", synchronizer="$synchronizer", type="send-confirmation-response"})
    -
    sum without(member) (daml_sequencer_client_traffic_control_event_delivered_cost_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", synchronizer="$synchronizer", type="send-confirmation-response"})
)[2m:10s])

spec.title: Extra Traffic Purchased over the last 24h
Rejected Event Traffic Rate By Reason
spec.description: Displays the cost per second of events that were sequenced but not delivered successfully aggregated by the reason for the rejection.

spec.title: Confirmation Request Rate By Application ID
spec.description: Shows the traffic consumed due to confirmation requests submitted by this participant (per application ID) along with the consumption due to confirmation responses..
